description:
The PRO 4.0 electric moto sets a new standard for off-road performance. Engineered for superior power and precise handling, this e-moto delivers a dynamic riding experience.

Advanced features integrated into the PRO 4.0 allow for extensive customization, enabling riders to fine-tune their experience to specific terrains and preferences. This design ensures optimal control and adaptability in diverse off-road conditions.

As specialists in electric rideables, E RIDE PRO offers the PRO 4.0 for riders seeking a high-performance off-road electric motorcycle. It combines robust engineering with rider-focused features for a reliable and engaging ride.

ULTIMATE PEAK POWER

Superior battery power, durable motor, and outstanding controller, altogether add up to the supreme capability for a powerful off-riding journey.

ALL TERRAIN & VERSATILE

E Ride Pro is built to be ridden off road, giving riders the versatility to conquer rugged landscapes with ease, as well as mountainous conditions for adventures into the wilderness.

ZERO EMISSION ENGINEERING

The finest, lightweight, non-polluting electric motorcycle ever made. An ideal choice for modern riders who embrace the future of ecological sustainability.
